dedupe_keys.name: cleaned cernet backbone network topology dataset

description: Jian Cheng and colleagues publish a cleaned domestic backbone representation of the China Education and Research Network. They derive it from the Internet Topology Zoo network attributed to Knight and colleagues in 2011. Four international gateway nodes are removed and one duplicate Shijiazhuang node is merged, reducing the original 41 nodes and 59 edges to 36 nodes and 54 edges. Zenodo provides GEXF topology, CSV node attributes and a CSV edge list free under CC BY 4.0. The July 2026 release date does not establish that the underlying network reflects 2026 infrastructure. The files support reproducible routing and disruption experiments on a fixed domestic graph; omitting international gateways limits cross-border analyses. This is a specific transformation of data-internet-topology-zoo, whose existing parent record does not explicitly name this cleaned derivative.
